g.text: Takeaway: grating teeth + taper on the silicon layer = grating coupler; edge and grating couplers both reach < 1 dB per interface;

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8.7px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: Si waveguides treat the two polarizations differently, so circuits are built for one polarization and duplicated (polarization diversity).
